title: The Trouble with Traditions: The Split over Eldred’s Traditional Contours Guidelines, How They Might Be Applied, and Why They Ultimately Fail
journal: Tulane Journal of Technology & Intellectual Property
description: Examines the traditional contours framework from Eldred v. Ashcroft, its differing application by the federal courts, and its shortcomings as a guide to First Amendment scrutiny of copyright law.

title: Golan v. Gonzales: How Copyright Restoration Alters the Ordinary Copyright Sequence and Invites First Amendment Review
journal: Tulane Journal of Technology & Intellectual Property
description: Analyzes the Tenth Circuit’s decision on restoring copyright protection to foreign works previously in the public domain and the resulting First Amendment questions.

title: Virtual Reality in Education: Irish and American Students Meet on the Virtual Frontier
proceedings: ACM SIGGRAPH ’98 Conference Abstracts and Applications
intro: My interest in emerging technology goes back to my undergraduate years. In 1998, I coauthored a conference abstract on the use of virtual reality in education, published in the proceedings of ACM SIGGRAPH ’98.
